paragraphs.text: The Ten Summits is a range of mountains in Stonehaven , the western part of Corondor on the plane of Dominaria .
The mountain-range of the Ten Summits lies south of the Plains of Urlan , and north of Ephren . The most prominent of the Ten Summits is the volcanic Oremon .
These mountains were part of the ancestral heritage of House Carthalion , and Adam Carthalion used their mana during the Battle of Aster Fall .
